title: Training Over-parameterized Models with Non-decomposable Objectives
summary: Operationalizes our NeurIPS 2021 release on training over-parameterized models with non-decomposable objectives — maximizing worst-case recall via a logit-adjusted cost-sensitive loss — as a data-platforms capability for long-tail classification, benchmarked on the CIFAR-10/100 long-tail datasets against ERM, balanced-loss and re-weighted baselines.
